line_items.work_text: Approval for additional amount of Rs. 5,98,670/- for insurance of ASDMA’s five Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) and repair of one damaged UAV from available fund of ASDMA under capacity building component
Approval of proposals of PWD Roads Department under SDRF for the year 2022-23
Ex Post Facto approval for taking over of NDMA sponsored Project "Emergency Response Support System for Disaster Emergencies (ERSS-DM)" by ASDMA as per MoU signed between NDMA and ASDMA.

narrative: The meeting discussed various approvals including financial sanctions for UAV insurance, PWD proposals under SDRF, and the ex post facto approval for the NDMA project.
